comment: teleport.c control_mon_tele(): with montelecontrol in debug mode, a Wizard zaps a wished wand of teleportation at a newt, moves the destination cursor onto the room's top wall and answers 'y' to "force anyway?", so rloc() places the newt in the wall. Before yes/no answers were characters, the port compared that answer with 'y' and always picked a random destination.
